research_question: Can genuinely distinct point-in-time signal sources, daily shock detection and transparent regime switching produce stable SPY exposure management after correcting for all prior BRACE-SPX hypothesis trials?

sampling.unscheduled_override: daily shock gate may only reduce exposure

regime_switching.primary: transparent deterministic low-vol, high-vol, panic and recovery states
regime_switching.reason: HMM complexity, state-label instability and additional hypothesis burden are not justified until the transparent regime model passes the strict development gate.

macro_policy.active_macro_proxy: market-implied rates, Treasury duration and US dollar
macro_policy.vintage_macro_challenger: allowed only after point-in-time release-vintage data and publication-lag tests are supplied

options_policy.data_quality: fail closed if the historical series is unavailable or insufficient

development.chronological_validation: six one-year daily folds with five-trading-day purge

multiple_testing.correction_scope: all BRACE-SPX candidate spaces from generations 1-5 plus Architecture 2

single_champion_allowed_only_if: median fold-rank correlation is at least 0.30
no more than three unique fold winners
champion_policy.otherwise: no champion; track every predeclared candidate in parallel

external_validation.primary_and_external_engine_must_match: signal dates, exposure path, turnover and net returns within declared tolerances

shadow_trading.reason: Using holdout observations to warm indicators would constitute holdout access.
